description: Count the days between two dates: total days (optionally including the start day), weeks and days, years/months/days, Japanese business days (excluding weekends and Japanese national holidays from the Cabinet Office list) and weekdays (Mon-Fri). Exact calendar arithmetic, no time zones. Dates 1873-01-01 to 2200-12-31.

include_start_day.description: Count the start day too (e.g. 2026-01-01 to 2026-01-01 = 1 day). Default false.

lang.description: Language of the user. Use "ja" when the user writes in Japanese (affects the source link and notes). Default "en".

name: days_between
title: Days Between Two Dates
